results.content: ## The president is getting bad news from his base with less than 3 months to the midterms. Donald Trump is getting a major warning from his own party as a string of new polls show Republican support for the president slipping sharply ahead of the midterms. An Economist/YouGov poll released Tuesday put Trump’s approval among Republicans at 79 percent, down 12 points from January 2025. A Financial Times poll found Trump’s net approval among Republicans had fallen eight points in one month, while an ActiVote survey also found Republican approval at 79 percent, down from 86 percent in January 2025. According to The Economist and YouGov, more people disapprove than approve of Trump’s job performance in 47 out of 50 states and in the District of Columbia. results.content: # Trump approval rating sinks to yet another low in new poll. President Donald Trump’s polling woes continue as he fell to a new record low since his return to the White House, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos survey, with only one in three Americans approving of his job performance. The poll, released on Aug. 17, found that only 33% of Americans approved of Trump’s performance, down 2 percentage points from another Reuters/Ipsos poll from earlier this month. Trump’s performance on the Aug. 17 poll marks the lowest approval rating the president has seen in Reuters/Ipsos tracking since his return to the White House in 2025.
